title: Cubic root filter formula
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The indicator that the integer sum of the coordinates of $x$ is divisible by $3$ equals $\\frac13+\\frac23\\operatorname{Re}\\left(\\prod_{i=1}^n\\left(-\\frac12+\\frac{\\sqrt3}{2}x_i\\,\\mathrm{i}\\right)\\right)$, where $\\mathrm{i}$ is the imaginary unit.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate dimension n is a natural number
x is a sign vector of length n
